# On and off by default — the `stencil` pack

Back to [what a fresh install turns on](../defaults.md) · [every rule of the pack](../README.md#stencil).

- **Installed by `codelaw init` when:** `package.json` depends on `@stencil/core`.
- **Rules:** 18 — 0 on, 17 on with `preview = true`, 1 off in an opt-in preset, 0 in no preset.

## Presets

| Preset | Written by `init` | Rules | Severities | What it is |
|---|---|--:|---|---|
| `stencil/recommended` | yes, once the pack is installed | 17 | 17 error | @stencil/eslint-plugin 1.4.0 recommended without its type-checked rules, reimplemented |
| `stencil/conventions` | no — opt in | 1 | 1 error | House conventions from codelaw's starter catalogue |

## Rules

`on` runs in a fresh install; a `preview` rule runs only with `preview = true` ([SR-RULE-PACKS](../../../records/0101_rule-packs.md) decision 9). † a preset `init` writes only when the repo has what it is for.
